'''Finnick Isle''' is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. This isle, together with The Finnick Island nearby, are listed as protected islands. Development on these islands are forbidden.

Transport

This isle is separated from The Finnick Island by an extremely narrow channel. Therefore, in theory, tourists can visit this island on foot.

Fun Facts

  • This island is named after a former city administrator that is nicknamed Finnick.
  • This island is one of the three islands in West Metropolis Archipelago that are named after Finnick, the other two being The Finnick Island and Nick Fin Island. However, it should be noted that he does not own any of these three islands. Instead, he owns Brain Island.

  • While this station was originally meant to be completely underground, subsequent development had seen the concourse having a skylight in a fashion similar to Pinestand Station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_OJlQbf2ZKQ&t=140s</ref>
  • To allude to the name of this station, flags are erected at the chairs of this station.
  • A small section of Oceanfloor Tubes exist to the west of this station.
  • As the Chinese Name of the vicinity of this station has bad omen, the name of this station is modified to its current name. Interestingly, the Nawis Railway Station 400m to the west of this station uses the name of the area instead. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rZ3OYjP5QQg&t=877s</ref> However, the English Name of Kum Kei Wan Station does not directly reflect the English Name of the Vicinity (Kum Kei '''Bay''').   • Exit C is added to this station to ensure that the station remains accessible in the event that the Logistics Center on top of this station is sealed off.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rZ3OYjP5QQg&t=1059s</ref> A similar arrangement was also seen at Origin Court Station with regards to the Origin Underground Street.

Line Charcteristics

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Among the Season 1 Lines, this line is the last one to be planned and established.
  • Named after the fact that this line mainly serves Flask Industrial District.
  • The south section of this line plays a larger role than that the north section.
  • This line interchanges with twice, once to the north in Spike End Station and once to the south in Lower Oasis Station.
  • The three consecutive stations in Ingress, Internal Sea and Flask for concidentally contains the word "East" (East Margin Station, Internal Sea East Station, Flask East Checkpoint), and the three stations are located in different districts.
  • and had rumors regarding the two lines merging, and there were several coincidences or evidences hinting such possibilityDuring the first phase development of , there were multiple notes scattered around those stations stating that "7A and 8 will merge".</ref>The Station Code of two lines are aligned with one another (as seen from Gunshot Island Station and Peacean Island Station where both of them are (XX)-14 and (XX)-15 respectively).</ref>The way this line switched aligning direction is identical to Tuen Ma Line in real life.</ref>. However, as Nazca Railway has planned as an east-west oriented line serving Odyssey during the late-S3 period (can be referred from Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition), and these two lines did not merge when they transfer at Peacean Island Station, the possibility of merging has since become extremely low.
  • After this line extended to Peacean Island Station, it replaced as the line with the most station types.
